parameters.num_potential_turbines: <int> Number of candidate turbine sites in the region.
parameters.num_substations: <int> Number of fixed grid substations in the region.
parameters.num_steiner_nodes: <int> Number of intermediate cable routing points that cannot host turbines.
parameters.total_nodes: <int> Total number of locations (substations, candidate turbine sites, and Steiner nodes).
parameters.total_edges: <int> Total number of feasible cable connections between pairs of locations.
parameters.quota: <float> Minimum total annual energy yield that the selected turbines must collectively achieve.
parameters.alpha: <float> Weight given to financial cost in the combined objective, with the remainder weighting scenic impact.

nodes.x: <float> Horizontal coordinate of this location in kilometers.
nodes.y: <float> Vertical coordinate of this location in kilometers.
nodes.cost: <float> Installation cost of building a turbine at this location (zero for substations and Steiner nodes).
nodes.profit: <float> Annual energy yield from a turbine at this location (zero for substations and Steiner nodes).
nodes.scenic_impact: <float> Visual burden imposed on the landscape by placing a turbine at this location (zero for substations and Steiner nodes).

edges.id: <int> Unique identifier for this cable connection.
edges.from: <int> Node identifier of one endpoint of this cable connection.
edges.to: <int> Node identifier of the other endpoint of this cable connection.
edges.cost: <float> Financial cost of laying this cable segment (zero between substations).
edges.scenic_impact: <float> Visual burden imposed on the landscape by this cable route (zero between substations).
